# darktalent.tech

darktalent is Moneyball-style talent scouting, the hiring side of skill.supply. It rates legends living and dead as collectible trading cards, lets you build dream squads from them, and surfaces undervalued talent the market overlooks. Every person gets a card scored on six stats (Vision, Execution, Influence, Innovation, Capital, Grit) that roll up into one overall number and an Elo score that every head-to-head vote moves. The core paid product is The Shortlist: a founder or hiring manager pastes one job description and gets five scored candidates matched to that seat, with the evidence behind every number. The thesis is signal over pedigree: legacy filters overprice the right school and the right logo, so the self-taught and the outsiders stay underrated.

## Pricing
The Shortlist: $500 per shortlist (five candidates matched to one job description, delivered in five business days). Full refund if none of the five earn a first interview. The $500 credits in full against the placement fee (20% of first year salary) if a hire is made from it. Buy: https://buy.stripe.com/dRmaEX9340OhcME6KtaMU1F
